caption: The drawing is a monochromatic, black ink illustration on a beige or light tan background, depicting a decorative wrought iron balcony or window railing in front of a rectangular window with four large glass panes. The window is sketched with diagonal hatching to indicate shading or reflection. The central focus of the railing is a large circular medallion featuring a symmetrical design with curved lines, scrolls, and small diamond shapes arranged evenly around the center. On both the left and right sides of the medallion, there are identical vertical wrought iron sections with a repeating geometric and scroll pattern, including diamond shapes framed by curved elements. Below the railing, horizontal lines suggest the presence of a ledge or a sill, with further hatching beneath it. A thin double-line rectangular border frames the entire drawing, with each corner featuring a simple square and line motif. In the lower right corner, the words "The CABILDO" are handwritten, adding a label to the drawing.
title: Window Grille
